Figure 1.
Outline of Taxol biosynthesis from primary metabolism. The enzymes indicated are geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase (GGPPS) and taxadiene
synthase (TS). Ac, Bz, and OPP denote the acetate and benzoate groups, and the diphosphate moiety, respectively. IPP and DMAPP indicate isopentenyl
diphosphate and dimethylallyl diphosphate, respectively.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2.
Reconstructed pathway from primary metabolism to taxadien-
5a-acetoxy-10b-ol. The enzymes indicated are GGPPS, taxadiene synthase
(TS), cytochrome P450taxadiene 5a-hydroxylase(THY5a),taxadien-5a-ol-
O-acetyl transferase (TAT) and cytochrome P450 taxoid 10b-hydroxylase
(THY10b). Ac, Bz, and OPP denote the acetate and benzoate groups, and the
diphosphate moiety, respectively. IPP and DMAPP indicate isopentenyl
diphosphate and dimethylallyl diphosphate, respectively.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3.
Immunoblotting and activity assays demonstrate the coex-
pression of GGPPS and TS inyeast. YPH499 cells harboring pYES-GGPPS
and pYES-TS (or empty vector control pYES2-NTA) were grown in SD-
uracil medium and harvested at the indicated times post-induction. Each
lane in the immunoblot (A) contained 10 mg soluble protein which was
detected with anti-Xpress monoclonal antibody. The assays for GGPPS
activity (B) and the coupled activity for TS in the presence of GGPPS (C)
are described in the Materials and Methods. The open symbols in each
panel represent the activity levels of the corresponding empty vector
controls.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4.
Immunoblotting demonstrates expression and localization
of three cytochrome P450 taxoid hydroxylases in yeast. For the 10b-
hydroxylase (THY10b panel A), which was coexpressed with the
taxadienol acetyl transferase (TAT), YPH499 cells harboring pESCW-
TAT-THY10b or the empty vector control pESC-TRP (pESCW) were
grown in SD/SG-Tryptophan medium and harvested at the indicated times
post-induction. Each lane of the immunoblot time course (A, lanes 1–10)
contained 10 mg of the corresponding crude protein extract which was
detected with anti-FLAG monoclonal antibody. At the 24 h time point, the
crude extract was subjected to ultracentrifugation and the corresponding
soluble protein fractions (sol, lanes 11 and 13, 10 mg protein) and
microsomal fractions (ms, lanes 12 and 14, 10 mg protein) were identically
analyzed. For the 13a-hydroxylase (THY13a, panel B), YPH499 cells
harboring pESCH-THY13a or the empty vector control pESC-HIS
(pESCH) were grown in SD/SG-Histidine medium and harvested at the
indicated times post-induction (note the inverted time axis). Each lane of
the immunoblot time course (B, lanes 1–6) contained 25 mg of the
corresponding crude protein extract which was detected with anti-VSVG
monoclonal antibody. At the 24 h time point, the crude extract was
subjected to ultracentrifugation and the corresponding soluble protein
fractions (sol, lanes 7 and 9, 10 mg protein) and microsomal fractions
(ms, lanes 8 and 10, 7 mg protein) were identically analyzed. For the
5a-hydroxylase (THY5a, panel C), YPH499 cells harboring p425GPD-
THY5a or the empty vector control p425GPD were grown in SD-Leucine
medium and harvested at the indicated times. Each lane of the immunoblot
time course (C, lanes 1–6) contained 15 mg of the corresponding crude
protein extract which was detected with anti-HA monoclonal antibody. At
the 24 h time point, the crude extract was subjected to ultracentrifugation
and the corresponding soluble protein fractions (sol, lanes 7 and 9, 15 mg
protein) and microsomal fractions (ms, lanes 8 and 10, 15 mg protein) were
identically analyzed.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5.
Immunoblotting demonstrates expression of three taxoid acyl/
aroyl transferases in yeast. For the taxadienol 5a-O-acetyl transferase (TAT,
panel A), which was coexpressed with the taxoid 10b-hydroxylase
(THY10b), YPH499 cells harboring pESCW-TAT-THY10b or the empty
vector control pESC-TRP (pESCW) were grown in the appropriate medium
and harvested at the indicated times post-induction. Each lane of the
immunoblot time course (A, lanes 1–4 and 6–10) contained 10 mg of the
corresponding soluble protein extract which was detected with anti-c-Myc
monoclonal antibody. For the taxoid 2a-O-benzoyl transferase (TBT, panels
B and C) and taxoid 10b-O-acetyl transferase (DBAT, panels B and C),
YPH499 cells harboring pESCL-TBTor the empty vector control (see pESC,
panel A), pYES-DBAT or the empty vector control pYES2NTA, or both
vectors for coexpression were grown in the appropriate medium and
harvested at the indicated times post-induction. Each lane of the immunoblot
time courses (B and C, lanes 1–6) contained 10 mg of the corresponding
soluble protein extract which was detected with anti-c-Myc monoclonal
antibody (for TBT) and anti-Xpress monoclonal antibody (for DBAT).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 6.
Immunoblotting demonstrates expression of ﬁve enzymes for
the biosynthesis of taxadien-5a-acetoxy-10b-ol in yeast. YPH499 cells
were co-transformed with pESCU-GGPPS-TS, pESCW-TAT-THY10b and
p425GPD-THY5a, selected on SD-Ura-Trp-Leu medium, induced in SG-
Ura-Trp-Leu medium, and harvested at the indicated times post-induction.
Each lane of the immunoblot time course contained 20 mg of the
corresponding crude protein extract which was detected with anti-FLAG
monoclonal antibody (for TS and THY10b), anti-c-Myc monoclonal
antibody (for GGPPS and TAT), and anti-HA (for THY5a). The X-ray ﬁlms
were exposed for 1.5 min (top two panels) or for 5 min (bottom panel).

Figure 7.
Capillary GC-MS analysis of the lipid products generated by
yeast cells harboring the three plasmids described in Figure 6 (for expression

of GGPP (geranyllinalool and geranylgeraniol) are indicated. The large
peaks eluting between 12.3 and 16.6 min are steroidal compounds that are
also produced by the wildtype yeast host; low levels of the solvolysis
